Now Do You See Why An America First Economic Agenda Was So Valuable?
October 16, 2021
|
Sundance
|
144 Comments
Economic Security is National Security….
The Trump Doctrine
The only person in my lifetime to inherently understand how to change a national economic program to benefit the middle-class was Donald J. Trump.  And I don’t even think he knew it on a scholarly basis – he just knew in his gut what steps to take to benefit the American worker on Main Street.
Only Donald Trump had the mind to see downstream consequences of economic policy and then re-engineer those programs; along with a keen ability to apply a  level of strategic policy to protect our interests {
EXAMPLE
}.  All other potential candidates are politicians by nature and incapable of reversing our decay.

Phil McCoxwell
October 17, 2021 9:38 am
None of this is new. It is simply now visible. Now, with each move, each charade, every narrative, their moves are out in the open and more people are watching.  As Sundance always says, once you see the strings on the marionette, you can’t unsee them.  The lefts biggest problem is a whole lot more of us are now eyes wide open.   We will take our country back. I have absolute Faith in God that we will. However, to do so, we as a country need to turn back to God. THIS is the greatest fear the left has. Our reinstating the prominence of God into our daily lives and our institutions is the end of leftism (which is truly Satan himself).   The worship of materialism has brought us here. Don’t get me wrong, nice things are nice things, but the believing your life can only be complete if you are surrounded by nice things is where our country has lost its way.  It is the pursuit of things vs the pursuit of a relationship with Jesus Christ that has brought this darkness upon us.   We are now all being tested to see if we will cling to our stuff or have faith and be willing to lose it all.  These times definitely add clarity to the saying that the love of money is the root of all evil.  Just look at how many people who will not stand up out of fear for losing their job. It is a very hard decision, but that is where we are.  We have to be willing to lose it all, burn all bridges of retreat and know that though we walk trough the valley of the shadow of death that God Almighty is with us every step of the way.
